Are you looking for a full-time job in logistics? Then you are at the right place at PostNL in Waalwijk. We offer you a long-term job with security! Guaranteed 4 days work! Also, you can earn up to € 29,42 per hour. Curious about what awaits you as a warehouse employee at PostNL in Waalwijk? Read on quickly!

What we offer
- Salary: € 14,99 per hour!
- On Sunday you earn € 29,98 per hour!
- Guaranteed 32 hours!
- Allowances of 20% and 30% after 10 pm
- Weekly payment!
- Travel allowance from 6 kilometers

Who you are
As a full-time warehouse employee at PostNL Waalwijk, you will be busy with packages all day. This means a lot of standing, walking, and lifting packages. Also:

- You have your own transport to come to PostNL in Waalwijk
- You speak the Dutch or English language
- You are able to remove all piercings, jewelry, and earrings for your workday.
- You are available for a minimum of three days
- You are available either the morning or evening shift
- You are in the possibility to lift parcels up to 20 kg, if needed.

What will you do
As a full-time warehouse employee at PostNL in Waalwijk, you will help support the sorting process. This ensures that every package goes out on time and can be delivered to the correct address. All packages are placed on the conveyor belt by another department. Then the sorting machine sorts the packages by region. After that, the packages fall into different chutes near you. Then comes the final sorting. This is done by postal code. You check the postal code and place the package in the correct roll container behind you.

- Working days: Monday to Sunday (weekends are on a rotational basis).
- Working hours: Day shifts from 09:00 AM - 18:30 PM and Evening shift from 17:30 PM - 02:30 AM

Where will you work

Do you enjoy working with your hands and with different materials?

Composite material is made up of multiple materials bonded or laminated together. Think panels, interior parts, and structural aircraft components. As a Composite Shop Worker, you'll repair and maintain these parts. You're comfortable working with a range of materials: composite, plastic, metal, and interior materials. You carry out repairs according to fixed technical specifications and work instructions, working precisely with professional tools in a hangar or workshop environment. You'll also identify and resolve damage to interior and composite components, a role that combines the best of sheet metal work and interior work.

- You have experience working with different materials, or a relevant technical education (e.g. in sheet metal work, composites, or interior construction)
- You have a precise, careful way of working
- You're willing to (further) build your technical expertise
- You speak good English (technical drawings are all in English)
- You're comfortable working with computers; administration is also part of the job
- You're willing to occasionally work evenings and weekends (on average once every 4 weeks - after 8 months from starting)
- Experience in car body repair, automotive interiors, or manufacturing work involving composite/plastic materials is a plus

Are you looking for an active job in logistics?

As a Logistics Associate at DHL, you will work together with your colleagues to ensure a smooth sorting process. You will process packages so they can be delivered to customers on time.

Your responsibilities include placing packages on the sorting conveyor belt, processing sorted shipments, and supporting the daily logistics operation. You will work Monday to Friday and be available 3 to 5 days per week. Shifts start around 5:00 PM and end around 2:45 AM. Start and end times may vary.

Packages can weigh up to 25 kg. If a package is heavier or difficult to lift, you will always lift it together with a colleague.

- You are available for at least 3 to 4 days per week
- You are at least 18 years old
- You speak Dutch or English
- You live in or around Zwolle, Meppel or Kampen
- You have your own transportation (car, bicycle or scooter) or live within walking distance of the sorting center

Are you ready for a flying start with a spectacular salary? As a logistics employee at DPD in Berkel en Rodenrijs, you will earn a great base wage of € 14.99 per hour. But it gets even better! You will work only in the morning, so the rest of the day is free! On top of that, we can discuss your schedule that fits your life perfectly. Read on quickly and claim this top job today!

What we offer
- A top salary of € 14.99 gross per hour 💸
- A lot of free time!
- Weekly payouts right after the weekend
- Travel allowance 🚗
- A great chance to get a permanent contract

Who you are
Do you love precision and speed? As a logistics employee, you see it as a sport to guide every package smoothly through the warehouse. You are reliable and ready to make an impact. To keep the warehouse running smoothly, it is important that you meet the following criteria:

- You are 18 years or older to ensure workplace safety
- You speak English or Dutch
- You have your own transport to reach Berkel en Rodenrijs

What will you do
Working as a logistics employee at DPD means action, energy, and great rewards! You are the driving force behind the sorting process. Together with your team, you make sure that all packages end up in the correct containers at lightning speed. Because you work efficiently, the time flies by, and your bank account grows fast. It is an active job that keeps you fit while you earn cash easily!

Where will you work
You will work in the modern DPD warehouse at the Celsiusstraat in Berkel en Rodenrijs. The working atmosphere here is informal, warm, and full of fun. Hard work and laughing together go hand in hand! After your shift, you can relax in the cozy canteen with a fresh cup of coffee. DPD truly believes in your talent and offers opportunities to grow your career! #baanrader

You work in a modern production environment where hygiene and quality are important. As a Production Worker, your work is varied and the results of your work are visible right away.

Preferred:

As part of an international organization, you will play an important role in ensuring that materials and products move efficiently throughout the production process. Your contribution helps keep operations running smoothly and supports the delivery of high-quality products worldwide. What’s your job about? As a High-Tech Logistics Operator, you are responsible for supporting the daily logistics activities within the organization. You ensure that materials are available when needed and that outgoing products are prepared and shipped correctly. Your responsibilities include: Packing and preparing products for shipment. Processing and preparing outgoing orders. Transporting materials and goods within the warehouse and production areas. Working with logistics systems such as SAP. Monitoring the flow of goods and reporting discrepancies. Supporting an efficient and error-free logistics process. Contributing to continuous improvements within logistics operations. This role goes beyond traditional warehouse work. You are an essential link between logistics and production, helping to ensure that materials are available at the right time and place.
